user.title: Add a compatibility camera
user.description: Select an existing camera with a local RTSP source. Its credentials and encoding remain in the source app. This creates a separate H.264/AAC MPEG-TS HLS camera, without modifying the source camera.

error.invalid_source: Select an existing RTSP camera, not another Local HLS Camera.
error.source_unavailable: The source camera is unavailable or has no readable stream source.

abort.already_configured: This source camera is already configured.

init.title: HLS packaging
init.description: These settings only change packaging, not encoding. Use short keyframes in the source app. Preload is controlled by Home Assistant's standard camera stream setting.
